name: Mary Brophy
bio: Mary Brophy of Mingusville visited Medora with Annie Brophy in November 1884 and again in January 1885. In December 1886 the paper listed her among old-timers, at home in Mingusville.
mentions: Misses Mary and Annie Brophy return this evening to their home in Mingusville. We hope to see them here often.
Miss Mary Brophy, of Mingusville, is visiting her many friends in Medora.
